name: disfruleg-bodega
description: Portal web para el encargado de bodega — Disfruleg

scripts.dev: lsof -ti :3030 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/icu.ubicuo.disfruleg-bodega.plist 2>/dev/null; node --watch server.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/icu.ubicuo.disfruleg-bodega.plist; launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/icu.ubicuo.disfruleg-bodega.plist && sleep 2 && tail -5 ~/disfruleg-bodega/logs/server.log
